title: Moving a part between Part Sales still reprices nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tiers were set, with a part in category A priced $135.00.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 2, for customer B, made after customer B's tiers were set.
  • Make sure matrix A's Default was changed to Markup % 50 after the part was priced.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Move the part to Part Sale 2.
  3. Open Part Sale 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sale 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The part leaves Part Sale 1.

Step 3:

  • On Part Sale 2 the part reads $135.00, not $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50).
